title: Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation combining quantitative frame-by-frame annotations of text and images by culture representatives, qualitative focus group discussions to identify misalignment mechanisms (e.g., stereotyping, omission, forced insertion), and comparative validation of automated LLM-as-a-judge scores.

Evaluating the appropriateness of linguistic registers, including dialects, code-switching, and forms of address (e.g., analyzing regional Portuguese usage in a Mozambican context) via community representative annotations and feedback.
